segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: Good morning Alice. What brings you to the clinic today?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Hi Doctor. I have had a runny nose, mild sore throat, and a low fever for two days.

segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: Any shortness of breath, chest pain, or wheezing?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No shortness of breath and no chest pain at all.

segments.speaker: DOCTOR
segments.text: Your throat is mildly erythematous, lungs are clear to auscultation. This looks like a viral upper respiratory infection. I recommend rest, hydration, and acetaminophen 500mg as needed.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Understood doctor, thank you very much.
